The Ground Remembers

Every recorded unit position across all 675 five-minute snapshots, accumulated into one map -- so the places that saw fighting again and again stand out, permanently, instead of resetting with each tick.

Built from the same 694 recorded unit positions that drive the main map's playback (not the separate, more granular per-scene density files) -- so this shows where units were positioned most often across the battle, as a proxy for where the fighting concentrated.
